requirements_summary: SMB helpdesk SaaS; primary workload = chat-based support assistant + ticket summarization. Target p95 latency goal: <= 300ms for 'snippets'/short-turn replies; willing to accept up to 2s for long summaries. Throughput: bursty, ~20-100 reqs/min depending on campaign. Cost sensitive (startup budget). Prefers public cloud hosted API (self-serve). Wants model that balances quality & cost (open models ok if parity to high-quality blackbox). Needs SSO and audit logs. Routing: prefer NA for NA customers, EU for EU customers — currently all routed to eu-west causing inconsistent tail latencies. Wants default timeouts + recommended prompt size guidance.
notes: Inbound SMB lead — self-serve trial. Key pain = latency + occasional timeouts. Dev notes: logs show timeouts at 15s default on client; p95 token latency spikes in eu-west during peak hours. Customer quote: "We love the output quality but users complain responses are slow compared to chatbots we tested." Shorthand from call: - mostly public cloud, no private KMS yet - high sensitivity on per-ticket cost; concerned about prompt token bloat - uses long ticket context (avg 1.8k words) and was naive about max_tokens; wants guidance on truncation vs retrieval - current integration polls for full sync, no streaming implemented - observed better latency when switching to model variant with lower context length - asks: how to pick region? how to set client timeout? how to reduce perceived latency? Actions recommended so far: 1) advise region pinning per user locale (us-east for NA, eu-west for EU), 2) increase client timeout to 25s for long summaries but implement streaming for short replies, 3) provide prompt trimming examples and a small retrieval layer (embeddings+RAG) to avoid sending full ticket text, 4) enable prefix/KV caching for repeated conversational contexts, 5) suggest smaller model variant for high-volume short replies and fallback to higher-quality model for full summaries. SE Diego to send sample trimmed prompts + cost comparison table. Next: 30m perf tuning + handoffs to growth for potential upgrade if SLA needs emerge.
